entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Thank you for all your assistance today.[n]You helped me discover some truly[n]wonderful inspiration.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I must say... I never expected my art[n]skills would ever prove useful for the[n]Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I have to hold up my end of the deal,[n]so I'll perform to the best of my ability.[n]You need only ask.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I should be the one thanking you.[n]Without your help, I could not have[n]finished today's piece.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Are you afraid to impose? Please,[n]you needn't worry.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Indeed? Then you can count on me.[n]My brush is yours to command.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Now, we should be heading back. I have[n]to apply the finishing touches as soon as[n]possible!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hah... For the first time in a long while,[n]my brush will dance again.
